name: Dynamic Home
description: Dynamic, permission-aware home recommendations for Jellyfin.
overview: Configurable and personalized sections for the Jellyfin home screen.

versions.changelog: Stabilizes rapid mobile touch swipes with complete row membership before interaction, eager mobile artwork, and progress refreshes deferred until scrolling stops. Verified through normal Jellyfin Dev catalog installation at 390×844: all 22 sections, 64 favorites and 34 continue-watching cards remained intact after rapid alternating swipes.

Fixes mobile rows turning visually blank after scrolling. Adds previous/next arrows to every row header and hides horizontal scrollbars while retaining touch and keyboard scrolling. Verified through normal Jellyfin Dev installation and mobile acceptance at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 pixels.

Refreshes continue-watching after returning home, preserves resume and next-up entries without a second combined cutoff, and prefers the most recently resumed episode per series. Verified by normal Dev catalog installation, real stop/resume and next-episode playback tests, and mobile layout acceptance.
Responsive layout: consistent 16:9 library tiles and 2:3 posters, reliable card spacing and narrow-screen settings. Verified through normal Jellyfin Dev installation and desktop/mobile acceptance.

Shows dynamic recommendations as soon as their feed is ready while slow Jellyfin progress requests finish independently, preserving the mobile startup and incremental-rendering improvements from 1.0.1.18.
